text: No, we cannot certify that no fire occurred on the asset (ASSET-F06) during the period 2026-10-06/2026-11-05. While no thermal anomalies were detected by NASA FIRMS sensors (VIIRS and MODIS) during this time, the absence of detections does not guarantee no fire occurred. Small, short-lived, cool, or cloud-obscured fires may not be detected by satellite sensors. The evidence only confirms that no significant thermal anomalies were observed within the asset boundary during the specified period. Further investigation using higher-resolution data or ground-based methods would be required to definitively rule out fires.
